GOLD_TROPHY.title: Unlock a Gold Trophy
GOLD_TROPHY.desc: Earn any Gold or Mythic tier trophy (<15% unlock rate).

INDIE_GAME.title: Play an Indie Game
INDIE_GAME.desc: Play or advance an indie title in your library for 20+ mins.

IMMERSION_SESSION.title: 1-Hour Immersion
IMMERSION_SESSION.desc: Play an unplayed or classic backlog game for 60+ minutes.

VAULT_STARTER.title: Vault Starter
VAULT_STARTER.desc: Start or play a claimed free game from your LootDrop Vault.

BEAT_GAME.title: Beat a Game
BEAT_GAME.desc: Finish any backlog game and mark it as Beaten in your Vault!

CONTROLLER_READY.title: Controller Ready
CONTROLLER_READY.desc: Play any game with verified Controller support for 25+ mins.

TROPHY_COLLECTOR.title: Trophy Collector
TROPHY_COLLECTOR.desc: Unlock 3 total trophies across any games in your collection.

MYTHIC_HUNTER.title: Mythic Hunter
MYTHIC_HUNTER.desc: Unlock an ultra-rare Mythic trophy (<5% unlock rate).

TRI_PLAY.title: Backlog Tri-Play
TRI_PLAY.desc: Play or log progress in 2 different games this week.

METACRITIC_80.title: Critically Acclaimed
METACRITIC_80.desc: Play a title with Metacritic 80+ for at least 30 minutes.

DECK_VERIFIED.title: Deck Verified Hero
DECK_VERIFIED.desc: Play any Steam Deck Verified title from your collection.

QUICK_SESSION.title: Bite-Sized Sprint
QUICK_SESSION.desc: Play a quick session friendly game (<30 min loop) for 15+ mins.

UNPLAYED_REVIVAL.title: Fresh Start
UNPLAYED_REVIVAL.desc: Boot up an unplayed backlog game and log 30+ minutes.

FIVE_TROPHIES.title: Trophy Sprint
FIVE_TROPHIES.desc: Unlock 5 total trophies across your entire gaming library.

COMPLETION_JOURNEY.title: Weekly Finisher
COMPLETION_JOURNEY.desc: Have 1 or more backlog games marked as Beaten in your library.

COMPACT_STORAGE.title: Lightweight Gem
COMPACT_STORAGE.desc: Play any game under 2GB storage footprint for 20+ minutes.

HEAVYWEIGHT_EPIC.title: Triple-A Immersion
HEAVYWEIGHT_EPIC.desc: Play a large 10GB+ title from your library for 45+ minutes.

GENRE_HOPPER.title: Genre Explorer
GENRE_HOPPER.desc: Play games across 2 distinct genres this week.
